Du arbeitest gerne mit Linux, löst technische Probleme und möchtest IT aktiv modernisieren?

Die PST Gruppe in Heiligenhaus ist ein Dienstleistungsunternehmen im Bereich Reparatur, Aufbereitung und Logistik technischer Geräte. Mit rund 85 Mitarbeitenden sorgen wir täglich dafür, dass Technik wieder funktioniert und Geräte möglichst lange genutzt werden können.

Auch unsere eigene IT möchten wir weiterentwickeln: weg von historisch gewachsenen Strukturen, hin zu einer modernen, schlanken und zuverlässigen IT-Landschaft. Dabei setzen wir künftig verstärkt auf Linux, Open-Source-Lösungen, Digitalisierung und intelligente Automatisierung.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der nicht nur IT-Probleme löst, sondern auch mitdenkt, bestehende Lösungen hinterfragt und Veränderungen aktiv mitgestaltet.

Deine Aufgaben

IT-Support und Anwenderbetreuung

  • Zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragen und Problemen sein.

  • Arbeitsplatzrechner, Drucker, Labeldrucker, Handscanner, Tablets und weitere IT-Geräte betreuen.

  • Arbeitsplätze einrichten, Software installieren sowie Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte verwalten.

  • Störungen analysieren und pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen finden.

Systemadministration und Infrastruktur

  • Unsere bestehende IT-Infrastruktur mit lokalen Servern, Netzwerken und Arbeitsplatzrechnern betreuen.

  • Grundlegende Administrationsaufgaben übernehmen, etwa bei Netzwerkdiensten und virtuellen Maschinen.

  • Für regelmäßige Sicherheitsupdates, Systempflege und die Kontrolle vorhandener Backup-Prozesse sorgen.

  • Bei komplexeren Aufgaben mit externen IT-Dienstleistern und Sicherheitsspezialisten zusammenarbeiten.

Linux und Modernisierung

  • Die geplante Umstellung von Windows auf Linux auf Arbeitsplätzen und in Teilen der Serverlandschaft aktiv begleiten.

  • Kenntnisse in Linux-Distributionen wie Linux Mint oder Ubuntu einbringen.

  • Geeignete Open-Source-Lösungen auswählen, einrichten und deren Einführung unterstützen.

  • Vorschläge entwickeln, wie sich unsere IT vereinfachen, standardisieren und wirtschaftlicher betreiben lässt.

Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung

  • Bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen und Möglichkeiten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung erkennen.

  • Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung moderne Arbeitsplatzkonzepte entwickeln, etwa mit einem sinnvolleren Einsatz von Tablets, Smartphones und zentralen Kommunikationslösungen.

  • Technische Optionen verständlich erklären und bei IT-Entscheidungen beraten.

  • Interne Entwickler und externe Dienstleister fachlich koordinieren, ohne selbst Software entwickeln zu müssen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Gute praktische Linux-Kenntnisse, besonders bei Desktop-Distributionen wie Linux Mint, Ubuntu oder vergleichbaren Systemen.

  • Erfahrung im Anwendersupport und Umgang mit PCs, Druckern, Scannern und anderen Endgeräten.

  • Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerk, Systemadministration und operativer IT-Sicherheit.

  • Ausreichende Windows-Kenntnisse, um die bestehende Umgebung zu betreuen und die spätere Migration zu begleiten – du musst kein Windows-Spezialist sein.

  • Eine IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare, nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung

About the role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team.

We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript.

  • Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

  • Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong.

  • Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback.

  • Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense.

  • Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence.

  • Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions.

  • Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

  • For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well.

Team's tech stack

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Data: DynamoDB, Postgres

  • Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway)

  • AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution

Requirements

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI.

  • Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position).

  • Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces.

  • Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

Nice but not required

  • Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization.

  • FastAPI and Pydantic experience.

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

  • Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

  • Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

  • Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.

  • Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.

  • Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.

  • Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.

  • High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.

  • A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.

Tech stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python

  • Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services

Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology

Du hilfst gern, behältst auch bei kniffligen Problemen die Ruhe und erklärst Technik so, dass sie jeder versteht? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner.

Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt.

- Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch.

- Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo.

- Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen.

- Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden.

- Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen.

- Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter.

- Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb.

Das bringst du mit

Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. Dazu kommunizierst du klar und freundlich - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich - und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Anliegen unserer Kunden.

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus

- Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients

- Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen

- Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

About Us

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.

About the Role

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

  • Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

  • Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

  • Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

  • Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

  • Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

  • Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

  • Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

  • An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

  • A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

  • Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

  • You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.

About the Opportunity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

column3: >Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

>Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

column1: Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.
This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

• You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

• Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
• Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
• Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
• Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
• Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
• Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
• Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
• Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
• Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate the cloud infrastructure platform behind our sovereign mission operations teams. You’ll make it safer and easier to deploy, upgrade, and run UFORCE services in on-premises environments, including sites with limited or no internet connectivity.

You’ll combine hands-on infrastructure engineering with practical operational ownership: automating deployments, strengthening reliability, and making sure customer IT and partner operations teams can run the platform with confidence. You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and customer-facing teams, with a focus on solutions that are secure, supportable, and usable in the field.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve deployment and maintenance automation for on-premises environments, including infrastructure as code, packaging, environment validation, and preflight checks.

  • Make releases and upgrades work reliably in offline or restricted-network settings: manage artifacts and versioning, define validation gates, and document staged rollout and rollback procedures.

  • Develop repeatable deployment patterns for VM-based, Kubernetes-based, and mixed environments, and document when and how to handle deviations.

  • Establish and maintain an observability baseline for constrained environments, including useful metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards. Make alerts actionable and link them to clear runbooks.

  • Define and operationalize service-level objectives and change-safety practices such as smoke tests, rollout checks, and rollback-first procedures.

  • Respond to incidents across deployed environments, coordinate diagnosis and communication, and turn lessons learned into improvements to automation, monitoring, and operations.

  • Create and maintain operational playbooks, troubleshooting guides, escalation paths, and maintenance workflows for customer IT and partner operations teams.

  • Partner with engineering and security teams to identify operational risks early and ensure new platform capabilities are ready to deploy and support.

  • Coach teammates on practical reliability habits, including debugging, alert quality, incident follow-through, and documentation.

About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of ""to do great work with really smart people"".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

The role

What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder.

You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work.

This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand.

But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it.

That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix.

You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them.

We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, analytics or another demanding environment and found yourself constantly looking for better ways to do things.

Either way, we want someone who gets excited by a problem they don't immediately know how to solve.

You’ll have a lot of support from experienced operators, engineers and product people, but also be given a lot of responsibility unusually early in your career. The aim is for you to quickly become someone who can take an undefined operational problem, understand it properly and build a robust solution.

It’s a rare chance to learn how a fast-growing technology company actually works from the inside while building the systems that allow it to scale.

We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Platform Engineering

column2:

Data Modeling &
column3:

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps &

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Owning your scope

About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients years.

Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. Because we can test treatments on these virtual patients at scale, we can predict, with causal evidence, how a patient will respond to a drug long before it reaches the clinic. This helps pharma companies bet on the right drugs, for the right patients, much earlier on.

We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe’s leading cancer centers, and we build on 10 years of research. We are backed by top international VCs and growing fast. Discover more here on Orakl’s website.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

  • Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

  • Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

  • The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

  • Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

  • Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

ai-unity-tools-engineer-paris-367793,Homa Games,AI Unity Tools Engineer,"

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio.

You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games.
  • Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable.
  • Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality.
  • Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling.
  • Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used.
  • Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations.

Requirements

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring

  • Hands-on experience with Unity and the ability to understand Unity games, game systems, and testing contexts.
  • Proven experience using AI systems, models, or AI-enabled engineering workflows in practice.
  • Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context.
  • Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks.
  • Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing.
  • Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment.
  • Experience supporting products with high testing volumes.
  • Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams.

Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership, early. This is a new initiative. Your tools will change how Homa and its studios build and test games, and you'll see the results.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We're committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what ""ready to run in production"" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

  • Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

  • Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging

Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system
column2:
it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

Our stack:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

  • Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

  • DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required:

  • Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

  • Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

  • Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware
column3:
comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics.

  • Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

  • Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

  • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

  • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

  • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

  • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

  • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

  • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

  • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

  • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

  • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

  • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

  • Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

  • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

  • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

  • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

  • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

  • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

  • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

  • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

  • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

  • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

  • Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

  • Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

  • CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

  • Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

  • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA

  • Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk!

Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg).

Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

This is a hands-on execution role. You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager, who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead, who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor

Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren?

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen

  • Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken.

  • Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen.

  • Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren.

  • Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies.

  • Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren.

We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken.

Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson &
column2:
Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across DACH. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a base of existing DACH customers to grow, plus real room to build new accounts and the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Open new private sector accounts across the DACH region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.

  • Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

  • Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

  • Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in DACH, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.

  • A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

  • Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.

  • Fluent German and English, French and additional relevant languages a bonus

  • Based in Germany and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.

  • You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, and occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
