About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.
column3:
margin-bottom:0px""> 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.
column5:
margin-bottom:0px""> 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them
column7:

What you bring

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

Description

QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers), you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM).

At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system?

You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level.

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

Neudata’s research team is at the core of what we do. Clients of Neudata have access to:

  • Our research portal, allowing them to browse our catalogue of dataset reports, each of which is written by a member of the research team and pertaining to a dataset (e.g. short positions data by vendor X)

  • Our research team’s expertise, allowing us to help them make informed data decisions (e.g. through calls where we share our opinion on the most appropriate dataset for their needs)

The Role:

Our expertise lies in the vast world of alternative data, spanning everything from social sentiment feeds and credit card transactions to complex ESG signals. As a Research Analyst, you will join the team dedicated to Scout, our premier platform for alternative data discovery. You will be largely interacting with:

  • Data buyers, by communicating our findings via research reports and calls, and

  • Data sellers, to understand their properties and potential use cases of different datasets

Your work will centre on translating complex, non-traditional datasets into actionable intelligence in a highly collaborative and inquisitive role that requires a blend of analytical thinking and clear, authoritative communication.

  • Conducting in-depth research on alternative data providers and datasets

  • Writing research reports on alternative datasets and industry trends

  • Interacting with our client base (data buyers and data sellers), primarily through research calls and emails

  • We highly encourage our Research Analysts to exercise independent thought and critical thinking, and believe this to be one of the most appealing aspects of the role

Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

  • Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

  • A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

  • Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

  • The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

Lua is the Agent OS. We build digital employees: agents that do a real job end to end. They read a company's own systems, make the decision, take the action, and get a little better every time they run. Not chatbots that answer questions, but digital workers that do the work, on the company's own data and workflows, and everything they build stays owned by the business. Teams write their logic on Lua (agents, skills, tools, jobs, webhooks, guardrails) and we run the hard parts underneath: infrastructure, multi-provider model orchestration, data, channels (WhatsApp, Slack, email, Instagram, Messenger, a voice-capable website widget, HTTP API) and monitoring.

About us

Our customers are the companies that run their markets: the operator of one of the world's most-visited heritage sites, a major travel and hospitality group, the largest supermarket chain in its country, a listed conglomerate spanning healthcare and consumer goods, large regional banks, a social-commerce company and a microinsurer covering over a million people, across Africa, the Middle East and South Asia. Together they employ 64,000+ people and turn over $5bn+ a year, and they all want the same thing: to be AI-native on the systems they already run, with nothing to rip out.

We are a lean team of 30, backed by Y Combinator, and we've raised $5.8M. We have deployed 10,000+ agents across 20 markets. Having scaled from emerging markets, we are now moving into the UK and Europe. This is our founding commercial hire in the region and, based on performance, will quickly convert into an AE Europe role.

The role

As Lua's first SDR in Europe, you sit at the top of the UK and EU revenue funnel and report to Hugo de Stacpoole, VP of Sales.

You will prospect personally into priority mid-market and enterprise accounts using LinkedIn, phone, email, events and warm introductions. You will also direct an AI-native outbound stack that handles research, sequencing and first-touch personalisation, and step in when a human conversation will do more than another automated touch.

There is no playbook yet. You will help define how Lua sources, qualifies and hands opportunities to Account Executives in the region, including the qualification criteria. You are judged on qualified pipeline and revenue contribution, not activity alone.

What you'll do

  • Run outbound end to end. Identify target accounts and decision-makers across the UK and Europe and book qualified meetings for the sales team.

  • Maintain a prioritised target account list with AEs and leadership, and tune it using results.

  • Direct and refine our AI SDR tooling. Set up, monitor and improve automated sequences and enrichment workflows.

  • Qualify with discipline. Run early discovery and pass only opportunities that meet agreed criteria.

  • Hand over cleanly to sales and help define the handoff standard.

  • Track funnel quality from outreach to meeting to qualified opportunity to revenue, and act on the gaps.

  • Keep the CRM accurate so the team has a reliable view of the pipeline.

  • Sharpen the pitch by feeding back what prospects actually say.

  • Track the market, including competitors, buyer trends and regulation such as the EU AI Act.

  • Support partners and events that turn into new pipeline.

What we're looking for

  • You have been the first SDR somewhere and built the outbound motion from nothing.

  • Two or more years of B2B prospecting, ideally selling SaaS, AI or other technology to mid-market or enterprise buyers.

  • You can talk credibly about AI and AI use cases across multiple industries.

  • You know the UK market well. A European network or a second European language is a plus.

  • You can explain to a senior executive in a few sentences why Lua is worth their time.

  • You use AI outreach, enrichment and automation tools well, and you spot weak output quickly.

  • You manage your own pipeline and keep the CRM accurate without being reminded.

  • Experience at AI-native startups, B2B SaaS teams or expert networks is a strong fit.

  • Familiarity with Apollo, Clay and the major LLMs is a plus.

How success is measured

Meetings booked and held, qualified opportunities created, pipeline generated (direct and partner-sourced), stage conversion, handoff acceptance and speed, CRM data quality, and closed-won revenue from SDR-sourced opportunities.

What we offer

  • $38k base plus commission

  • Equity incentive plan

  • 25 days holiday per year, pro rata

  • London, hybrid, with minimal office time required

  • A direct path into a closing AE role, or into onboarding the next SDRs as the team grows

If you want to build Lua's European sales motion from the first account, let's talk.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Build Conveo's legal function from the ground up, and be the partner our leadership team relies on as we scale.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~125 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, Balderton, and Visionaries, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

What We're Building

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As our first Head of Legal, you'll build Conveo's legal function from the ground up. Strategically critical commercial agreements with enterprise clients and reseller partners are coming in, and they require sharp commercial and legal review to protect our revenue lines. You will advise on a broad array of legal topics across commercial, product, IP, employment and corporate matters, with the support of external advisors and tools where appropriate.

This is a partnership role. You'll report to our CFO and work hand in hand with them, with a strong dotted line to our CEO. You'll have full strategic and operational visibility across the organisation and help strike the balance between risk and opportunity. Conveo operates across Europe and the US, so you'll also support our New York team and work across jurisdictions.

You'll lead our legal associate directly and manage our external lawyers. Legal here is both sword and shield for our commercial team. You'll be commercially pragmatic: working with the business, you'll make proportionate risk calls on the deal as a whole, not clause by clause, and you'll be prepared to work at pace. You know that speed and clarity matter, and that sometimes legal rigour is what saves us down the road.

This role is based in our London office, in a hybrid setup (3 days a week in the office expected).

What You'll Do

Own our commercial contracts

  • Review and negotiate our most important client and reseller agreements: MSAs, DPAs, SLAs and order forms, often against enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • Own supplier contract reviews

  • Set fallback positions so deals don't stall, and tell the business clearly when to say no

  • Build templates and playbooks so sales can close standard deals without you

Build the legal function

  • Set up intake, templates, playbooks and a central contract repository

  • Decide what is handled in-house and what goes to external counsel, and keep spend in check

  • Select, brief and manage outside firms across jurisdictions

  • Lead and develop our legal associate, and grow the team as the company scales

Own corporate, people and IP matters

  • Keep corporate housekeeping in order across our entities

  • Work closely with the CFO and corporate counsel on any debt or equity fundraises.

  • Partner with our People team on employment and equity matters across the UK, Belgium, the US, and any new market we enter

  • Protect our IP and work with external counsel to protect our brand

  • Get the company ready for Series B and due diligence

Own the legal side of data privacy and AI

  • Have a say in how we build and use AI in our product, advising product and engineering to remain compliant with the changing landscape of AI regulation.

  • Create and own the data protection and AI terms in our client and supplier contracts, including DPAs and subprocessor terms

  • Develop and help manage our AI Governance across the company.

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months

  • You fully own the legal function

  • You've completed a deep-dive risk review of our contracts and processes, covering commercial, employment and terms and conditions, so we know what is in place and what is not

  • You've put a process in place to step into commercial agreements when needed

  • You have a handle on every open external counsel matter, and you're leading on our longer-standing legal issues

  • You've set up a working framework with our People team

  • You're shaping how legal acts as both sword and shield for our commercial team

  • Depending on when you join, you've started preparing the company for Series B and due diligence

After 6 months

  • We contract with clients in a fundamentally better way, through a new contracting process

  • There's a clear legal intake process across HR, corporate, IP and commercial

  • You have strong working relationships with sales, product, engineering, finance and People, and everyone knows legal is the place to go for any agreement

  • Our legal associate works independently and is growing as a legal professional

  • Our external counsel spend is planned and predictable, with outside advice focused where it adds the most value

What You'll Bring

You're high agency and low ego, self-directing and startup-native. You stay calm with a long backlog, and you're genuinely interested in AI tools. You'll also bring:

  • 10+ years qualified in any UK or EU jurisdiction, with private practice followed by in-house experience

  • Experience leading an in-house legal function, ideally as head of legal or GC at a SaaS company, with the creativity and drive to build things from scratch

  • Deep commercial experience, including IP and liability: MSAs, DPAs, order forms, and negotiating with enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • A track record of building legal process from scratch: templates, playbooks, intake, a contract repository

  • Experience running external counsel across several jurisdictions and keeping spend in check

  • Working knowledge of employment, equity and corporate matters across multi-entity groups, with exposure to the UK, US and Belgium.

  • Comfort making risk calls and closing imperfect contracts, and giving clear, usable advice to non-lawyers and board-level readers

Nice to Have

  • Fundraising experience on the fund or company side

  • US legal experience

  • Experience with data privacy (GDPR) and AI regulation, such as the EU AI Act

  • Experience with cross-border data transfers between the UK, EU and US

  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle tools and AI-assisted contract review

Why Join Us?

  • Build the legal function at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • A true partnership role, working directly with our CFO and CEO

  • Meaningful equity. We want you to own a piece of what we're building.

  • Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so 3 days a week in the office is required.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to: Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000

Votre mission consiste à expérimenter différents outils, concevoir et optimiser des prompts, générer des contenus vidéo et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de leur qualité pédagogique et visuelle.

À la fois créatif(ve), rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous participez à la construction d’une méthodologie permettant de produire des contenus cohérents, réalistes, accessibles et adaptés aux objectifs de l’Activité Physique Adaptée.

column13: >Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques.
column14: >Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur.
column15: >Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément.
column16: >Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques.
column17: >Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs.

column37: >La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel.
column40: >Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable
column43: >Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle.
column46: >Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse
column49: >Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature.
column52: >Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA

L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche «
column13: >Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant.
column14: >Les objectifs principaux du projet sont :
column15: >Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique.
column16: >Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori.
column17: >La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant.
column24: >La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse.
column30: Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin
column32: >Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille.
column33: >Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle.
column34: Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif
column35:
Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone.

Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur.

Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires.
column37: Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif.
column38: Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel
column39:
Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement.

Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales.
column40: Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin
column41:
Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …).

Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés.

Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle.

column43: Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

solutions-consultant-geneva-216397,OpenSpace,Solutions Consultant,"

As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.
• Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract
• Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer
• Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE
• Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases
• Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers
• Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders
• Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)
• Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing
• A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience
• 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company
• A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets
• Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written
• Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH
• A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking
• Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC
• Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools
• Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus
• Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus
• Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.
• A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.
• Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.
If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur.



Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire.

Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F.

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison.

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

  • Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
  • Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
  • Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.
  • Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés.
  • Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture.
  • Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif.
  • Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents.
  • Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
  • Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.


Profil :

  • Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines.
  • Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire, obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration.
  • Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire.
  • Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales.
  • Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.
  • Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers.
  • Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH.
  • Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles.
  • Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit. La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout.
  • Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive.


Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ?

  • Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain, au cœur de la vie de la Maison.
  • L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours.
  • Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation.
  • Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur.
  • Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève.
  • La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage.


Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison.



Nos offres d’emploi s’adressent autant aux femmes qu’aux hommes.

Was bluu bewegt

Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen.
Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.

Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich.
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

  • Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

  • Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

  • Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

  • E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle.
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

  • neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

  • Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

  • neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

  • nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

  • Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

  • Du filmst und schneidest selbst, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

  • erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

  • Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

  • Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

  • echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

  • ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

  • Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

  • ein Büro mitten in Zürich, Homeoffice bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche

  • bis zu zwei Wochen pro Jahr arbeitest du, von wo du möchtest

  • enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem ganzen Team, auch bei neuen Produktideen

  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen: Wenn etwas Sinn macht, probieren wir es aus

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten)
Erzähl uns:

  1. was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

  2. Warum genau du perfekt für die Stelle passt

  3. wo du aktuell den grössten Hebel für bluu siehst

  4. eine konkrete Content-Idee für @bluuwash

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.

  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.

Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.
column2:
>

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue.

  • High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models.

  • Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

  • Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements.

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

About the Team

The Implementation team onboards our Premium, Pro and Enterprise customers onto the Perk platform, guiding them from signup to launch. We provide consultative, administrative, technical and educational support, and recommend ways to optimise each client's experience.


About the Role

The Senior Implementation Specialist is a change management and consultative expert who owns the onboarding and successful adoption of our Enterprise clients. You dig deep into client needs, define the best onboarding strategy, and lead change inside the customer's organisation. You bridge platform capabilities and client expectations, delivering a 7-star experience from first contact through long-term success.

You ensure new clients are fully prepared to book business travel on Perk: configuring accounts to their requirements, supporting integrations and troubleshooting, and getting users ready through tailored training. You are confident steering clients towards the recommendations that serve them best in the long term, even when these differ from their original request.

Technical expertise is central to the role. You are the in-depth expert on the Perk Travel platform and its configuration options, and you understand integrations and open APIs well enough to guide clients and their IT teams through marketplace partner and custom-built setups. You can troubleshoot issues, translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and recommend the most effective mix of automations, integrations and platform features for each client. You also learn new tools and concepts quickly as the product evolves.

You are also a mentor for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation, trusted as a source of expertise both internally and externally.



Responsibilities

  • Be the first impression of Perk and the first point of contact for clients and escalations throughout implementation, always delivering 7-star service.

  • Hold consultative conversations to gather client requirements, and answer them with experience and data-driven best-practice recommendations.

  • Own the timeline, rollout plan and account while it is in implementation, preparing and executing onboarding plans with strong project management and directing work across the internal team.

  • Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success.

  • Act as a technical solutions expert: identify the best solutions for each client's needs, prioritising automations, integrations and the full range of platform functionality.

  • Configure client accounts to their specifications and provide technical support and troubleshooting, including setting up integrations with marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions.

  • Plan and deliver tailored training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.

  • Lead cross-functional projects, keeping all internal stakeholders aligned on the goal of full customer ramp-up. Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Finance.

  • Prioritise accounts based on client and business needs.

  • Simplify complex technical information for all audiences.

  • Support Pre-Sales by explaining what an implementation will look like and how the platform can meet prospects' needs.

  • Validate configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behaviour after launch, and proactively offering support or recommendations.

  • Review completed implementations to improve your own process and the team's, following a cycle of execute, assess, improve, repeat.

  • Mentor colleagues and set an example for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation.


What we look for

  • A customer-first mindset, focused on a smooth onboarding and on what clients need to be happy in the long term.

  • A proven track record as a high achiever in an Implementation Specialist role, with previous experience working with Enterprise clients.

  • Success managing and delivering complex, international projects in a fast-paced environment, including defining scope and handling changing requirements while keeping the project on course.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to clarify their requirements and concerns clearly and professionally.

  • Superb communication skills, and the ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally, adapting your approach as needed.

  • A thoughtful, consultative approach to making recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Organised, structured and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills, creativity in solutions and keen attention to detail.

  • Tech-savvy, with an understanding of basic technical concepts around integrations and open APIs, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

  • A solution-oriented, proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, spotting opportunities to improve things for clients and the team.

  • Excitement for challenges and a personal drive to make a difference.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Dit is Shiftbase

Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn.


Wat ga je doen?

Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten.

Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort.

Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee.

Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan.

Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek.

Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar.


Wie ben jij?

Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen.

Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre.

Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech.
