About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who.

What you will achieve in your first 12 months

  • You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

  • You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.


What the job really looks like

  • A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

  • You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.


What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

  • Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

  • Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

  • Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.


What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.


Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

  3. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Our mission and why it matters

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area.

What you’ll own and drive

You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps.

• In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps.

What makes you thrive here

You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude.

You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor.

To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region.

Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow.

You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide.

Cooper Moss Rutland (CMR) is an independent, award-winning project controls consultancy supporting some of the UK's most complex construction and infrastructure programmes.

You would be joining a function that has grown quickly and has room to improve. We want someone who will run the core processes reliably and then make them better, rather than accepting them as they are. The Opportunity

Depending on experience, the role could sit at Finance Manager or Financial Controller level. This is a part-time role, typically two to three days a week, with fixed days agreed in advance and including the month-end close.

At Finance Manager level, you would own the day-to-day finance function, month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow.

At Financial Controller level, you would take broader responsibility for the control environment, processes and the external accountant relationship, with junior support handling the transactional workload.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who can build and improve the finance function as CMR continues to scale.

column2:

  • Bring the month-end close timetable down and hold it there, so the Partners have management information early in the following month rather than at the end of it.

  • Track actuals against budget and forecast each month, and investigate the variances rather than simply reporting them.

column3:

  • A background in industry rather than practice. We are not looking for someone moving straight from an accountancy firm.

  • Comfortable being hands-on. This is a small finance function, but day-to-day transactional processing is handled by the Finance Assistant.

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is ""not well enough"", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement)

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad.

You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't.

The squad works across three areas:

  • Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model.

  • The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from.

  • New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches.

The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead.

The role

As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems.

You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows.

Live project examples:

  • Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use.

  • Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning.

  • Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers...

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision.

  • Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending.

  • Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance.

  • Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

standortentwickler-berlin-223147,EuBiA,Standortentwickler (m/w/d),"

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

  • Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
  • Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
  • Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
  • Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
  • Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
  • Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
  • Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.

Was du mitbringst

  • Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
  • Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
  • Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
  • Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
  • Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
  • Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
  • Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.

Was wir dir geben

  • Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
  • Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
  • Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
  • Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
  • Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
  • Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
  • Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

column3:

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer for Data and Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Data collection: keeping our external data integrations reliable as sources and APIs change

  • Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

  • Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

  • Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

  • Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

  • Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

  • Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices.

About the Role

Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases.

Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on

  • Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more

  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams

  • Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements

  • Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security

  • Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market

  • Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration

  • 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products

  • Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus

  • Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike

  • Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements

  • Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making

  • Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product

  • Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath

  • Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget

  • Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. column2:
we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

  • You build the eval before you trust the result.

  • You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is designed to accelerate your development.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

What you'll do

  • Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

  • Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

  • Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

  • Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

  • Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

  • Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

  • Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for

  • You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

  • You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

  • You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

  • You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way.

  • You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

What sets you apart

  • You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company.

  • You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output.

  • You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes

  • Practical experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, Agentic AI concepts, and Human-in-the-Loop implementation approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of architecture and solution design, while leading delivery within agile development teams.

Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in AI-enabled solutions and services on SAP BTP.
  • Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP Integration Suite, and API management capabilities.
  • Previous experience leading small development teams within banking, public funding, or regulated financial environments.
  • German language skills.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all — the agility, enthusiasm, and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence, and extensive customer network of a more established organization.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and empowers you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you can chart your career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.
Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.
It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.
• Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.

Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen?

Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten.

Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Über OIXIO

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche.

Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung.

Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt.

  • Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite.

Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst.

At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

Research questions you could initially work on

  • Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

  • Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

  • Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

  • Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

Your main responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

  • Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

  • Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

  • Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

  • Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

  • Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

  • Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research.

  • Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding.

What a great fit looks like

  • A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning.

  • Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research.

  • Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.

  • An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

  • A strong interest in climate mitigation.

You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does.

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

About Us
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

Content Audits & Quality Assessment
● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

Content Strategy Development
● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

AI & Agentic Discoverability
● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

Testing & Performance Monitoring
● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

Creative Briefing & Review
● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and
marketplace advertising content.
● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

Client Management
● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

Quality & Output Review
● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

AI-Enabled Working
● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.
● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.
● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.
● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.
● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.
● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.
● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.
● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.
● Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.
● Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.
● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.
● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.
● Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.
● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.
● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.
● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

What We Offer
● Competitive salary and benefits
● Hybrid Working Model
● Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
● Continuous learning & career development
● The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

valve-lead-engineer-toulouse-456147,Pangea Propulsion,Valve Lead Engineer,"About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Senior Valve Engineer (Technical Authority) based in Toulouse.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves. The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems.

The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus, starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves. The scope can then expand to other valve families and propulsion programmes based on risk, recurring cost, lead time, supply-chain dependence, and strategic value.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong technical leadership. You will work closely with Fluidics and across Systems, Design, Analysis, Materials, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations, taking decisions from first principles and carrying them through to validated hardware.

Key responsibilities

· Act as Pangea’s technical reference for valves, owning design decisions, technical reviews, risk acceptance, and the valve technology roadmap across propulsion programmes.

· Define the valve internalisation strategy and prioritise candidates using performance, safety, development risk, recurring cost, lead time, supplier dependence, and manufacturing scalability.

· Lead the initial Nereus workstream for HTP-compatible solenoid valves: capture requirements and interfaces
column4:

· Own the full product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, trade-offs, detailed design, analysis, materials and sealing selection through prototyping, testing, qualification, production release, and in-service improvement.

· Establish verification logic, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, test matrices, and qualification evidence for nominal, off-nominal, proof, endurance, environmental, and compatibility testing.

· Ensure compatibility with HTP and, as applicable, cryogenic, high-pressure, hot, reactive, or hazardous fluids through disciplined materials, cleanliness, sealing, lubrication, and contamination-control choices.

Education

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.
